notes.title: Fresh Update Released!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that a brand-new update for Duel to The Holes is now live!

This update brings a variety of improvements aimed at making your experience smoother, sexier, and more immersive than ever. While we won't spoil the specifics, rest assured that under the hood, we’ve fine-tuned several elements to ensure everything feels tighter, cleaner, and more satisfying — just the way you like it.

As always, your feedback continues to inspire us and helps shape future updates. Whether you’re a first-time player or a seasoned hole duelist, we’re committed to delivering the best possible adventure.

Stay tuned for more exciting additions, tweaks, and surprises on the horizon. And as always… thank you for playing!
